description: Returns the full SDK reference (markdown) wired to ONE game's key/endpoints: realtime rooms, player identity (anonymous + claim/login), the datastore (saves/stats/inventory), leaderboards, player-created content (level sharing / UGC), and durable shared MATCHES for asynchronous turn-based play. Read this before writing client code that uses logins, saved progress, leaderboards, shared player-made content, or any game a player closes and comes back to. Pass `game` when the studio has more than one: every snippet carries that game's publishable key inline, and shipping the wrong one silently pools your players into another game.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.
